title: helpRequestsAndroid
description: Schema for a document in the 'helpRequestsAndroid' collection. Help requests submitted via the Android app, identifying people in need of outreach.

uid.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user who submitted this help request.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the help request was created. Represents a Firestore Timestamp.

title.description: A short title summarizing the help request.

description.description: Free-text description of the person in need and their situation.

identification.description: Physical description or identifying information of the person in need.

status.description: Current status of the help request (e.g., 'Need Help', 'In Progress', 'Resolved').

skills.description: List of skill categories needed to address this request.

outreachEvent.description: List of outreach event IDs associated with this help request.

location.description: Location where the person in need is located.
